name: Transfers to many newly created crypto addresses
description: Repeated small or fixed-amount transfers to many fresh or new crypto addresses.
fp: Privacy-conscious users and wallet software that rotates addresses can produce this pattern.

links.name: Withdrawals to many fresh addresses in fixed amounts
links.ctx: Balances are split into many near-identical outputs sent to newly created wallets (peeling or splitting pattern).

links.name: Retail users with repeated small transfers to many new addresses
links.ctx: Frequent low-value outbound transfers to different external wallets after small incoming crowd-sourced payments.
